AdvancedSettings.ucPresetHint: NovelAI Undesired Content preset. None sends only your own negative prompt.
AdvancedSettings.textRenderingHint: Words NovelAI V5 should render in the image. Appended to the very end of the prompt as "Text: …". English, Japanese and Chinese are supported.

AdvancedSettings.samplerHint: NovelAI sampling algorithm. Euler Ancestral is the official default and what every run used before this control existed.
